_comment: Pinned runtime for the release bundle. Both sha256 values were fetched and
verified on 2026-08-28, not copied from another project on trust:
nssm  - by downloading nssm-2.24.zip (351793 bytes) and hashing it
node.version's MAJOR is a release gate: changing it forces a MAJOR bump and
a full bundle, because a patch overlay ships no runtime and cannot bridge an
ABI change. See deploy/preflight-release.ps1 and RELEASING.md.
Windows only, deliberately. GCIO deploys to Windows behind IIS, and a Linux
bundle cannot be cross-built here anyway: the Linux Node tarball ships
npm/npx/corepack as symlinks and needs the executable bit on bin/node,
neither of which Windows tar.exe or NTFS preserve.
